title: Muppet Treasure Island
about: Young Jim Hawkins and his Muppet friends sail off with a treasure map and a ship's cook named Long John Silver.
cue: Serve the main when Long John Silver cooks in the ship's galley.
faces: Roasted mini sausages glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard.
Crisp cheddar and black pepper crackers with apple and pickled onion.
Rizzo's rat tourists already had seconds.
Tomato fish stew with white fish, prawns and potato, garlic toast.
Billy Bones' Benbow Inn steak and mushroom pie
Billy Bones never paid for a single one.
Dark chocolate brownies topped with chocolate coins.
Ginger beer, pineapple, lime and orange over ice, no alcohol.
Mrs Bluveridge's nightcap at the Admiral Benbow.
When the bell rings: Serve the main when Long John Silver cooks in the ship's galley.
Everyone, please remain calm. Dinner is served, and the mutiny can wait until after dessert.
